title: Committer organisation diversity by repo
description: The Maintainers tab's table over committers instead of maintainers: per repo, how many committers it has, how many distinct employers they span, the largest employer and its share of resolved committers, and the independent / unknown counts. Read it against the Maintainers tab — a repo whose maintainers are single-employer but whose committers are not has a bench it could promote from. The 'unknown' count is higher here, so weigh a single-employer reading against it.
label: Committers
